vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-47845
vulnerability.description: Reactor Netty HTTP Server denial of service while parsing HAProxy Protocol headers.

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable behavior requires a Reactor Netty HTTP Server configured to accept HAProxy Protocol headers. Elasticsearch packages these jars only in outbound HTTP client integrations (Azure repository, ES|QL datasource and inference modules); the image does not instantiate the affected Reactor Netty HTTP Server path or expose an HAProxy Protocol listener through Reactor Netty.
statements.action_statement: Retain 1.2.18 until a compatible public 1.2.x fix exists or Spring Enterprise 1.2.19 artifacts are supplied. Revalidate this statement whenever the Elasticsearch integration changes or Reactor Netty is upgraded.
